hero.name: Leon S. Kennedy
hero.specialAbility: Whenever Leon wins a combat, add his winning card's boost value to the Treasure’s tracker. When you stop in a starting space on your turn, you may use Treasure’s to buy items from The Merchant.

ruleCards.content:
All shop cards start outside your deck. 
3 cost: Ammo restock - Draw 1 card
4 cost: Green herb - Heal 1 health
4 cost: Attaché Case - Add this card to your hand. 
6 cost: Tactical Vest - Add this card to your hand. 
6 cost: Red 9 Handgun - Add this card to your hand. 
8 cost: Rocket Launcher - Add this card to your hand.
ruleCards.title: The Merchant

name: Leon S. Kennedy
note: Art is INTERIM, self-hosted: the 14 fetched faces, the cardback and the hero token are mirrored from the author's original unmatched.cards payload (third-party RE4 screenshots and wiki imagery) into public/evergreen-decks/art/NQ5XP per the #446 self-hosting rule — wired as plain illustrations (imageUrl only, never cardImage) to be replaced by an unbrewed art pass later. Riot Gun's primagames source 403s, so that one face stays on the generated template. Verbatim titles (shop - rocket Launcher, Shop - Tactical vest, Shop - Red 9 Handgun, Shop - Attache case, Staggering shot, HandCannon) are the print the engine carries — do not fix.
